title: Change of the *congruence canonical form of 2-by-2 matrices under perturbations
abstract: We study how small perturbations of a 2-by-2 complex matrix can change its canonical form for *congruence. We construct the Hasse diagram for the closure ordering on the set of *congruence classes of 2-by-2 matrices.
